description: How an answer of the platform to a configuration read becomes the failure a provider reports: the HTTP status, the ErrorCode of the ErrorResponse body, and whether the failure is transient. Transient (408, 424, 429, and 5xx other than 501 and 505) means the provider falls back to its cache and keeps polling; definitive means a retry gets the same answer, so it fails even an optional startup. A failure at a refresh keeps the previous document. The response answers every request of the read, retries and a credential's single re-send of a 401 included. A json body is an ErrorResponse (Message, Hint, ErrorCode, written in PascalCase as the API writes them), sent with Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8; a field is left out rather than written as null. errorCode is the ErrorCode when it is not blank, otherwise null.
